metadata.name: Sierra Madre fault earthquake scenario
metadata.label: Scenario input, not a forecast
metadata.generator: scripts/build_earthquake.py (distance bands from the USGS fault trace)
metadata.basis: Fault traces from the USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database, Sierra Madre fault zone. Bands are check deadlines by distance to the fault, a stated assumption, not a ShakeMap.
metadata.neverMarksSafe: Homes outside every band get an extrapolated deadline, never 'safe'.
